1.w: (3:19) “For indeed the day is coming, burning like a furnace, and all the arrogant evildoers will be chaff. The coming day will burn them up,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. “It will not leave them even a root or branch.

2.w: But for you who respect my name, the sun of vindication will rise with healing wings, and you will skip about like calves released from the stall.

3.w: You will trample on the wicked, for they will be like ashes under the soles of your feet on the day that I am preparing,” says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.

4.w: “Remember the law of my servant Moses, to whom at Horeb I gave rules and regulations for all Israel to obey.

5.w: Look, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of the Lord arrives.

6.w: He will encourage fathers and their children to return to me, so that I will not come and strike the earth with judgment.”
